campaign: Üniversite için başka bir dünya var.
title: Asya’da Eğitim — Instagram Creative Breakout
format: Six independent 4:5 explorations: one cover + one interior for each direction; not a complete carousel.

directions.A: Cinematic Youth — immersive, image-led student-life photography, kinetic full-bleed crops and scale type integrated into scene.
directions.B: Bold Graphic / Kinetic — no photography; near-total typographic occupation, hard scale contrast, screenprint grain, collisions and a composition-specific logo notch.
directions.C: Experimental Editorial Collage — layered contemporary student/campus photographs, cut-paper interventions, translucent printed fragments and magazine-like asymmetry.

tool_usage.selected_image_edit: C-cover landmark cleanup only; the initial no-logo generation is retained beside the final logo-integrated image.
tool_usage.rejected_edits: Two targeted Turkish-copy edits (A-interior, B-interior) did not reliably preserve/fix lettering; not used in final comps.
tool_usage.backend: gpt-image-2 via connected ChatGPT subscription; user explicitly requested this backend.

copy_review.required_campaign_line: Üniversite için başka bir dünya var.
copy_review.note: The exact campaign phrase is checked on covers; five destination names were checked on relevant designs. Some image-model secondary headline letterforms/diacritics remain exploratory in the interiors; they are clearly flagged in the gallery and must be accurately re-typeset after human direction approval, before production.

logo_policy: Only complete manifest-listed canonical SVGs were composited after generation. No logo was included in any image-generation prompt. Geometry untouched. Composition-specific placements use P-01 at 352px minimum or D-04 at 200px minimum; exact position/approved light-dark variant recorded per image.
imagery_disclosure: All generated people/places are illustrative campaign imagery; no specific university or destination landmark claim is made.

comparisons.rejected_structure: repeat top headline / bottom signature with separated photo strip and broad flat fields
same type-led poster skeleton, fixed footer/logo and rectangular photo blocks
paper dossier grid, recurring corner logo, ruled lists and stable type zones
